history.p: Gade composed the first version of the D major quartet in the late summer of 1887, but then in February 1888 he decided to provide it with a new first movement and in June 1889 he revised the Scherzo before he decided to send it to Breitkopf & Härtel.

titlePage.p: (Skizze) / Kvartet / (2 Viol, Viola, Violoncello.) / D Dur / Op. 63. / Comp. Sommer / 1887. / NB Nyt 1ste Allegro / comp. Marts 1888.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink and pencil. Paper: 12 staves. On verso of title page ten bars for the first Allegro and 25 bars for the Finale in E minor for the second quartet. Paginated 1-30. Heading on p. 1: "Dette Allo.(comp. Juli 1887) dmoll (C) blev lagt tilside...(Bagefter som: (1ste Allo i Kvartet No 2 / NB E moll.) / Istedetfor (comp. Marts 1888) D dur (6/8) / Kvartet for 2 Violiner, Viola & Violoncello / af Niels W. Gade." First movement end-dated "Juli 1887" on p. 10; second movement end-dated "Juli 1887" on p. 16; third movement end-dated "I Aug 87." on p. 19; p. 20 blank; Finale end-dated "[Gade's musical signature] Septbr 1887 / Febr. 1888."

titlePage.p: Kvartet / for 2 Violni / 1 Viola / 1 Violoncello / comp. 1887. / [Gade's musical signature] Op 63.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 14 staves. Verso of title page blank. Paginated 1-24 from first music page. With minor corrections in pencil. First movement end-dated "[Gades signatur] Marts / 1888" on p. 11; second movement end-dated "Juli 87. / (14 Marts / 1888)" on p. 12. After the third movement Gade has written: "Omskreven i Juni 1889." Page 19 blank. Andantino end-dated "[Gade's musical signature] Aug. 1887." on p. 24; Finale end-dated "[Gade's musical signature] 18 Marts / 1888".
